newsitem.title: UK: ICI extends gain after Laing recommendation.
newsitem.headline: ICI extends gain after Laing recommendation.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Chemical Industries Plc advanced in morning trade on Tuesday as the market reacted to a "buy" recommendation issued by Credit Lyonnais Laing yesterday, traders said
The shares were up 8-1/2p at 776 by 0958 GMT, rebounding from a three-month low of 752p set yesterday.
"We've seen a bit of follow-through from the "buy" recommendation yesterday," said one market-maker.
A sales trader at a leading securities house added that a short position in the market was also contributing to the strength in the share price.
